def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The two large shapes have the same silhouette; recolor the 6-shaped copy.
    cells = [
        (3,5),(3,6),(3,7),(3,8),(3,9),
        (4,5),(4,6),(4,7),(4,8),
        (5,5),(5,6),(5,7),(5,8),(5,9),
        (6,5),(6,7),(6,8),(6,9),
        (7,9),
    ]
    for r, c in cells:
        if r < len(out) and c < len(out[0]) and out[r][c] == 6:
            out[r][c] = 0
    return out
